title: Amelia | Camel Jumpsuit with Tied Neckline and Wide Legs
bodyHtml:
Meet your new go-to piece for effortless style, from weekend brunch to dinner out. This camel jumpsuit features a flattering high neckline with a delicate tie detail, an adjustable waist belt, and wide-leg trousers with a fluid drape that skims your frame without clinging. Soft and breathable, it's designed to move with you all day long.

Why you'll love it

  • High tied neckline with subtle opening – a modern, feminine touch that sets it apart
  • Adjustable waist belt in matching camel for a custom fit that feels just right
  • Soft and breathable fabric keeps you comfortable from morning coffee to evening drinks
  • Wide-leg cut with beautiful drape that elongates and flatters every shape
  • Warm camel tone is endlessly versatile and pairs with everything in your wardrobe
  • Works for casual days, travel, or dressing up – one piece, endless occasions
  • Hard-to-find style that gives you effortless elegance without trying

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
